name: Baptist General Association of Virginia
aliases: Baptist General Association of Virginia (BGAV) / Norfolk Baptist Association
source_policy: Official BGAV sources only (bgav.org): the "What Virginia Baptists Believe" brochure published on bgav.org, which carries the BGAV's positions on Scripture, the Baptist Faith and Message, marriage, sexuality and the ordination of women.

nuance.title: Autonomy: what a BGAV label does and does not tell you
paragraphs: The BGAV holds no creed but the Bible. It affirmed the 1963 Baptist Faith and Message, not the 2000 revision, and leaves that choice to each church.
Whether a church ordains women, or calls a woman as pastor, is decided by that church, not by the BGAV. Gender and Leadership are graded YELLOW for that reason: check the church's own page.
The BGAV's published marriage and sexuality resolutions define marriage as one man and one woman. A church's own practice can still differ, and the church's own evidence decides its rating.

rule.text: Not on the published LGBTQ-affirming list, and an official statement defines marriage as one man and one woman → GREEN.
Fully independent congregations with no required common confession → AUTONOMOUS.

ledger.quote: The BGAV has no creeds but the Holy Bible.
The ordination of women and how they shall serve is a local church matter, not a BGAV matter.
The autonomy of the local congregation and the priesthood of the believer are the criteria by which the BGAV represents churches.
The BGAV has taken no subsequent action but, as an autonomous body of Baptists, still stands behind the 1963 statement as a matter for our autonomous churches to decide for themselves.
God created the marriage covenant as a lifelong commitment between one man and one woman
We affirm the biblical teaching that homosexual behavior is sinful and unacceptable for Christians.
Again, the messengers of the BGAV affirmed the biblical teaching that homosexual behavior is unacceptable for Christian ordination.

Our vision is to become greater agents of mission together with our networks of churches, partners, and leaders impacting the Kingdom locally, nationally, and globally with the Gospel of Jesus Christ.
